---
title: "Teaching with the IRW"
---

The IRW has real item response data from hundreds of instruments in one format, so it works well for teaching psychometrics. A student can fit a model to a reading test, a personality scale, and a cognitive task in the same afternoon. This page collects what we have for teaching: a course, problems for problem sets, workshop materials, and a datathon.

## A course

<div class="vignette-card teach-hero">
<div class="vignette-lang">Course <span class="teach-status">In development</span></div>
<div class="vignette-title"><a href="https://ben-domingue.github.io/irw-course/">Psychometrics with the IRW</a></div>
<div class="vignette-question" style="font-style: normal;">About forty stand-alone lessons, from what measurement is to item response theory, fairness, and models beyond the standard ones. You can teach the whole sequence or take single lessons: a course map shows each lesson's prerequisites. Every lesson works on IRW data, and many include interactive widgets, simulations that run in the browser, and problems at the end. The material grew out of EDUC 252 at Stanford.</div>
<div class="teach-modules">
<span>Foundations</span>
<span>Classical test theory</span>
<span>Factor analysis</span>
<span>Validity</span>
<span>Item response theory</span>
<span>Fairness and invariance</span>
<span>Using calibrated items</span>
<span>Beyond the standard models</span>
</div>

A few lessons to start with:

<div class="vignette-grid">

<div class="vignette-card">
<div class="vignette-lang">Classical test theory</div>
<div class="vignette-title"><a href="https://ben-domingue.github.io/irw-course/lessons/ctt-reliability.html">Classical test theory and reliability</a></div>
<div class="vignette-question">What does a reliability coefficient estimate, and what does it assume? Coefficient alpha, split halves, and parallel tests, computed on IRW data.</div>
</div>

<div class="vignette-card">
<div class="vignette-lang">Item response theory</div>
<div class="vignette-title"><a href="https://ben-domingue.github.io/irw-course/lessons/rasch.html">The Rasch model</a></div>
<div class="vignette-question">What does it mean to put people and items on the same scale? The model, its assumptions, and a first fit.</div>
</div>

<div class="vignette-card">
<div class="vignette-lang">Factor analysis</div>
<div class="vignette-title"><a href="https://ben-domingue.github.io/irw-course/lessons/fa-exploratory.html">Factor analysis I: exploring dimensionality</a></div>
<div class="vignette-question">How many dimensions does a set of items measure? Exploratory factor analysis and parallel analysis on real scales.</div>
</div>

<div class="vignette-card">
<div class="vignette-lang">Fairness and invariance</div>
<div class="vignette-title"><a href="https://ben-domingue.github.io/irw-course/lessons/dif.html">Differential item functioning</a></div>
<div class="vignette-question">Does an item behave the same way for different groups of respondents who have the same ability? Detecting DIF, and reading the item text to understand it.</div>
</div>

</div>

## Materials for your own course

<div class="vignette-grid">

<div class="vignette-card">
<div class="vignette-lang">Problem sets</div>
<div class="vignette-title"><a href="problems.qmd">Problems for your problem sets</a></div>
<div class="vignette-question">About twenty problems from EDUC 252, each built on an IRW table and linked to code: logistic regression, item analysis, the 1–3PL, priors, DIF, multidimensional models, polytomous models, unfolding, and more. Each problem links to the course lesson that covers it.</div>
</div>

<div class="vignette-card">
<div class="vignette-lang">Datathon</div>
<div class="vignette-title"><a href="imps2025-datathon.qmd">IMPS 2025 Datathon</a></div>
<div class="vignette-question">Predict accuracy on a Hearts and Flowers executive-function task from the stimulus, response time, and demographics. Comes with the train/test split, judging criteria, and readings, so it can be reused as a class project.</div>
</div>

<div class="vignette-card">
<div class="vignette-lang">Workshops</div>
<div class="vignette-title"><a href="workshops.qmd">Workshops & slides</a></div>
<div class="vignette-question">Slides and setup material from workshops introducing the IRW: UTSA IES Pathways Fellows, IOMW 2025, and the V International Meeting of Psychometrics and Neuropsychological Evaluation.</div>
</div>

<div class="vignette-card">
<div class="vignette-lang">Vignettes</div>
<div class="vignette-title"><a href="../vignettes/index.qmd">Vignettes</a></div>
